title: Valid credentials log the customer in and land on Accounts Overview
preconditions: The ParaBank home page is reachable
The account test/test exists
steps: Enter the username into the Customer Login username field
Enter the password into the Customer Login password field
expectedResults: The Accounts Overview page is displayed
The Account Services navigation is present

title: Invalid credentials keep the customer off Accounts Overview and show an error
preconditions: The ParaBank home page is reachable
steps: Enter a username that does not exist
expectedResults: The Accounts Overview page is not displayed
An error is shown to the customer
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the exact error text and its placement on the page are not specified by PB-2 — clarify the expected message and where it renders before asserting on it

title: Submitting the login form with both fields empty is rejected
preconditions: The ParaBank home page is reachable
steps: Leave the username and password fields empty
expectedResults: The Accounts Overview page is not displayed
unknowns: UNKNOWN: whether an empty submission is blocked client-side or reaches the server is not specified — clarify the expected behaviour and message

title: The password is never echoed back in plain text during authentication
preconditions: The customer is on the ParaBank home page
steps: Inspect the rendered page and the request URL for the submitted password
expectedResults: The password value does not appear in the rendered page
The password value does not appear in the page URL
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the banking constitution forbids echoing plain-text passwords, but PB-1 and PB-2 state no logging requirement — confirm this is in scope and whether server logs are also to be checked

title: A logged-in customer reaches Transfer Funds from Account Services
preconditions: The customer is logged in and on Accounts Overview
steps: Click Transfer Funds in the Account Services navigation
expectedResults: The Transfer Funds page is displayed

title: A transfer submitted with a valid amount and both accounts completes
preconditions: The customer is logged in
The customer is on the Transfer Funds page
The customer owns at least one account
steps: Enter a positive amount within the available balance
Keep or select a source account
Keep or select a destination account
expectedResults: A Transfer Complete! confirmation is displayed

title: The confirmation names the amount and both accounts involved
preconditions: A transfer has just been submitted successfully
steps: Read the confirmation message on the Transfer Funds page
expectedResults: The heading Transfer Complete! is displayed
The message states the transferred amount
The message names a source account and a destination account
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the source and destination may be the same account when the customer owns only one — confirm whether the assertion must tolerate identical account numbers on both sides

title: The confirmation links through to the debited account's activity
preconditions: A transfer has just been submitted successfully
steps: Locate the account activity link on the confirmation
expectedResults: The account activity for the debited account is displayed

title: A transfer of exactly zero is rejected
preconditions: The customer is on the Transfer Funds page
expectedResults: The transfer does not complete
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the banking constitution requires zero to be treated as a boundary case, but PB-4 does not state the expected handling — clarify whether a zero transfer is rejected, and with what message

title: A transfer of a negative amount is rejected
preconditions: The customer is on the Transfer Funds page
expectedResults: The transfer does not complete
unknowns: UNKNOWN: PB-4 does not state how a negative amount is handled — clarify whether it is blocked client-side, rejected server-side, or normalised

title: A transfer of more than the available balance is rejected
preconditions: The customer is on the Transfer Funds page
The available balance of the source account is known
steps: Enter an amount greater than the available balance
expectedResults: The transfer does not complete
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the requirement explicitly leaves insufficient-funds behaviour open — clarify whether the transfer is refused, allowed to overdraw, or queued, before this case can assert anything

title: A transfer amount with more than two decimal places is handled consistently
preconditions: The customer is on the Transfer Funds page
steps: Enter an amount with three decimal places
expectedResults: The amount shown on the confirmation matches the amount the system actually moved
unknowns: UNKNOWN: currency rounding is required as a boundary case by the banking constitution but no rounding rule is stated — clarify the rounding mode and the number of decimal places accepted

title: A completed money movement is recorded in an auditable trail
preconditions: A transfer has just been submitted successfully
steps: Open the account activity for the debited account
Locate the entry for the transfer just performed
expectedResults: An entry exists recording the transfer amount and the date
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the banking constitution requires an audit trail covering who, what, when and amount, but PB-5 and PB-6 do not state that the actor is recorded or visible — clarify what the audit record must contain and where it is inspected

title: A logged-in customer reaches Find Transactions from Account Services
preconditions: The customer is logged in
steps: Click Find Transactions in the Account Services navigation
expectedResults: The Find Transactions page is displayed

title: Transactions can be found by amount
preconditions: The customer is on the Find Transactions page
An account with at least one transaction of a known amount is selected
steps: Enter the known transaction amount in the amount field
expectedResults: Results for the selected account are displayed
Every returned transaction matches the searched amount

title: Searching by an amount with no matching transactions returns an empty result
preconditions: The customer is on the Find Transactions page
steps: Enter an amount that matches no transaction on the selected account
expectedResults: No transactions are listed
unknowns: UNKNOWN: PB-8 does not state what an empty result renders — clarify whether a message is shown or the table is simply empty

title: Transactions can be found by date
preconditions: The customer is on the Find Transactions page
An account with at least one transaction on a known date is selected
steps: Enter the known transaction date in the date field
expectedResults: Results for the selected account are displayed
Every returned transaction falls on the searched date
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the accepted date format is not stated and the one observed value is ambiguous between DD-MM-YYYY and MM-DD-YYYY — clarify the format before any date can be entered deterministically

title: A date outside the account's transaction history returns an empty result
preconditions: The customer is on the Find Transactions page
steps: Enter a date on which the selected account has no transactions
expectedResults: No transactions are listed
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the date format is not established, so this case cannot be executed until TC-017's clarification is resolved

title: A customer returns to Accounts Overview from another Account Services page
preconditions: The customer is logged in
The customer is on the Find Transactions page
steps: Click Accounts Overview in the Account Services navigation
expectedResults: The Accounts Overview page is displayed

title: The session no longer grants access to account pages after logout
preconditions: The customer is logged in
steps: Attempt to return to the Accounts Overview page
expectedResults: Account pages are not served to the ended session
unknowns: UNKNOWN: the banking constitution requires session expiry on logout and after inactivity to be asserted explicitly, but no logout or timeout behaviour is stated in PB-1 to PB-10 — clarify the logout flow and the inactivity timeout, or confirm they are out of scope for this requirement
